stories.headline_en: Douglas Stuart on new novel and Booker Prize nomination

stories.summary_en: Researchers have proposed a new theory about the cause of death of Botticelli's favorite model, a Florentine woman who died at age 23. The new explanation relates to a condition visible in her portrait.

stories.headline_en: Five sinister designs for Halloween

stories.headline_en: Design Miami Paris 2026 highlights

stories.summary_en: Wallpaper presents highlights from Design Miami Paris 2026, on view until 25 October at L'Hôtel de Maisons.
stories.summary_de: Wallpaper präsentiert Höhepunkte der Design Miami Paris 2026, zu sehen bis 25. Oktober im L'Hôtel de Maisons.

stories.headline_en: George Saunders on new novel "Nightwatch"
stories.headline_de: George Saunders über neuen Roman "Nachtwache"
stories.summary_en: George Saunders' new novel "Nachtwache" features a ghost visiting a dying oil tycoon. Saunders discussed the inspiration behind the unusual plot in an interview.

stories.headline_en: Camille Provost's sculptures at Palais Royal

stories.summary_en: French-Ivorian artist Camille Provost presents puzzle-like interactive sculptures at Acne Paper's exhibition space in the Palais Royal. Her work balances playfulness with intellectual depth.
stories.summary_de: Die französisch-ivorische Künstlerin Camille Provost zeigt rätselhaft anmutende interaktive Skulpturen im Ausstellungsraum von Acne Paper im Palais Royal. Ihre Arbeit verbindet Verspieltheit mit intellektueller Tiefe.

stories.headline_en: Publisher ends collaboration with author over AI-generated text allegations
stories.headline_de: Verlag beendet Zusammenarbeit wegen KI-Vorwürfen

stories.headline_en: Life magazine's dance archive reveals US cultural shifts

stories.summary_en: Life magazine, launched in 1936, regularly featured dance photography from the School of American Ballet and George Balanchine, capturing transformations in US culture through a visual lens. A new book collects these dan
stories.summary_de: Life-Magazin dokumentierte seit 1936 Tanzfotografien der School of American Ballet und George Balanchine als Spiegel kultureller Veränderungen. Ein neues Buch präsentiert diese Tanzbilder.

stories.headline_en: Clayface hailed as top comic adaptation
stories.headline_de: Clayface als beste Comicverfilmung gefeiert

stories.summary_de: Ein aufstrebender Schauspieler wird in "Clayface" zum Monster – beschrieben als beste Comicverfilmung seit Langem.

stories.headline_en: Rauschenberg digital catalogue raisonné launched
stories.headline_de: Digitales Rauschenberg-Werkverzeichnis veröffentlicht
stories.summary_en: A comprehensive digital catalogue raisonné of Robert Rauschenberg's work has been released. The project documents the artist's prolific oeuvre in searchable digital format.

stories.headline_en: Art professionals reflect on Scotland visit
stories.headline_de: Kunstfachleute reflektieren über Schottlandbesuch

stories.headline_en: Ginori 1735 launches Fortunae porcelain collection
stories.headline_de: Ginori 1735 lanciert Porzellan-Kollektion Fortunae
stories.summary_en: Ginori 1735 has unveiled Fortunae, a new porcelain collection of home decor and tableware inspired by a medieval board game. The collection emphasizes auspicious designs.

stories.headline_en: Bach architects redesign village house near Girona

stories.headline_en: Seven- and eight-figure sales at Art Basel Paris
stories.headline_de: Verkäufe im sieben- und achtstelligen Bereich auf Art Basel Paris

stories.summary_en: Demonstrators are using France's public landmarks to protest police violence, school underfunding, and cost-of-living crisis. Drawing parallels to May 1968 activism.

stories.headline_en: Exhibition of 17 women artists working with spirit
stories.headline_de: Ausstellung von 17 Künstlerinnen mit Geisterkommunikation
stories.summary_en: An exhibition brings together 17 women artists whose work emerges through spirit communication. The show is described as exceptional.
stories.summary_de: Eine Ausstellung vereint 17 Künstlerinnen, deren Werke durch Geisterkommunikation entstehen. Die Schau wird als außergewöhnlich beschrieben.

stories.summary_en: The Musée National des Beaux-Arts du Québec has opened a new $61 million space dedicated to Jean Paul Riopelle, the province's most celebrated Modern artist. The pavilion will display dozens of works by the artist.

stories.headline_en: Artist and gallerist Peter Nagy dies at 66
stories.headline_de: Künstler und Galerist Peter Nagy gestorben
stories.summary_en: Peter Nagy, an artist and gallerist who shaped art scenes in New York and New Delhi, has died at 66. He was a painter working in abstraction and a champion of Denver's art community.
stories.summary_de: Peter Nagy, Künstler und Galerist, der die Kunstszenen in New York und Neu-Delhi prägte, ist im Alter von 66 Jahren gestorben. Er war Maler und Förderer der Denvers Kunstszene.

stories.headline_en: Designer Olivier Mourgue, 87, dies
stories.headline_de: Designer Olivier Mourgue gestorben

stories.headline_en: Judge halts Colombia National Museum exhibition changes

stories.headline_en: Federico Veronesi captures mourning elephant in Namibia
